summary.intent: Continue Phase 72 (SDK write-plane durability) work: verify web-e2e flake fixes locally without CI, merge PR #600/#601 to close out a CI fire, then resume and drive Phase 72 planning and full autonomous execution (plan → execute → ship) through all 10 plan waves plus a user-directed hardening pass to fix pre-existing test TypeScript drift and wire test-inclusive typechecking into CI.
summary.outcome: PRs #600 and #601 merged after full local + dispatched CI validation; Phase 72 planning completed (RESEARCH.md, VALIDATION.md, 10 plans across 7 waves) and all 10 plans executed and gated green (sdk suite 389 passed/0 failed); additionally fixed 113 pre-existing test-file TypeScript errors across 5 packages and wired build-first test-inclusive typechecking into CI per user directive; final step (resolving 6 stale phase-63/65 skipped test blocks) was in progress when the transcript ends, so ship-phase had not yet run.

repo: `ci-e2e.yml` (Web/Desktop E2E) triggers only on push-to-main or workflow_dispatch, never on PRs — validate e2e fixes pre-merge via `gh workflow run <file> --ref <branch>` (not `-f ref=`, which 422s on older workflow definitions lacking that input)

Playwright web-e2e `ciFloor()` helper only raises wait timeouts to 60s under CI; local runs use the raw (often 15-30s) timeout, causing local-only flakes on IPNS-gated operations that pass fine in CI — to get representative local verification, patch `webServer.reuseExistingServer` off the `!process.env.CI` condition and run with `CI=1`

Cross-package `@cipherbox/*` imports resolve via workspace symlinks to each package's built `dist`, not path aliases or TS project references — so typecheck ordering must respect the build dependency graph (crypto→core→api-client→sdk-core→sdk)

Root `pnpm typecheck` only runs `tsconfig.build.json` per package (excludes test files) plus `tsconfig.scripts.json` — test files were never typechecked in CI despite the base `tsconfig.json` including them

Phase 71 (#599) shipped with three pieces of unresolved test/fixture drift: stale `.mts` DTO field names in desktop-e2e, a non-deterministic sdk-e2e Test 21 assertion, and it exposed a real FUSE seq-1 equivocation bug — a pattern worth watching for in future phase ships

Phase 70.1 collapsed two IndexedDB stores (`generation-high-water`, `seq-high-water`) into one `rotation-floor` store (DB `cipherbox-rotation-state` v2, keyed by nodeId) — old store names are gone, any code/tests still referencing them silently return undefined
cargo winfsp check fails on macOS due to `windows-future` dependency not compiling — expected, Windows CI is authoritative for that crate
GSD executor sandboxes can't read `.env`, so live sdk-e2e tests requiring secrets must be deferred to the orchestrator/phase-verification step

sdk test suite had drifted onto retired Phase-62 types (`FileMetadata`, `FolderChild`, `FolderEntry`, `FolderMetadata`, `rootFolderKey`) — a broader migration than vitest v2→v3 Mock-generics drift seen in sdk-core/api-client

code.finding: publish_file_node hardcoded seq=1 on first-publish; fixed by resolving IPNS first via resolve_ipns_for_replay — NotFound→first-publish, Found(seq)→route into publish_with_cas_retry with the resolved seq instead of re-resolving

publish_with_cas_retry gained an optional preresolved_seq param (per Greptile P2) to skip a redundant resolve round-trip on the Found path; conflict-retry path still always re-resolves since pre-resolved values go stale after a conflict

getWriteBodyParams (and its bin/index.ts twin) now throws on a genuine null IPNS resolve when a real (non-zero, 32-byte) writeKey is present, instead of silently sealing an empty write-body; the legitimate zero-writeKey read-only fallback path is unchanged

ciFloor() helper raises wait timeouts to a 60s floor only under CI — the asymmetry between local (short) and CI (floored) timeouts caused a chain of local-only flakes across full-workflow.spec.ts tests 4.10, 4.11, 2.1, 6.6.2, 8.2 that never reproduced the actual CI-passing behavior until CI=1 was forced locally

workflow: When a background local test run cascades on an early flaky test, blocking downstream target tests, don't whack-a-mole individual timeouts — reproduce the CI timeout regime directly (force CI=1 / equivalent config) rather than iterating fix→rerun→new-flake multiple times
For PR hygiene: fetch+rebase before push to avoid clobbering bot chore(release) commits, even on branches unlikely to have one
When a CodeRabbit/Greptile bot flags a valid-but-low-value optimization (e.g. double-resolve), defer widening a shared helper's blast radius unless asked — but apply promptly once directed

Capture scope-adjacent discoveries (e.g. pre-existing TS drift found while executing an unrelated plan) as a durable todo file immediately, rather than fixing inline or losing them to context — then sequence the fix as a dedicated final plan/pass
Use `gh workflow run <file> --ref <branch>` (not `-f ref=`) to validate e2e fixes against a branch head before merging, when the e2e workflow doesn't run on PRs

Sequence typecheck-before-build only works when cross-package type resolution doesn't depend on built dist output — in dist-symlink monorepos, build-first then typecheck-after is the correct order despite the user's initial ask

Verify a subagent's claimed commit landed via git log/cat-file rather than trusting a tool-reported timeout, since lint-staged/SSH-signing hangs can time out the harness's own bash tool without the underlying commit failing

friction: `gh workflow run -f ref=` returned HTTP 422 because main's workflow definition predated the ref input — required discovering the `--ref <branch>` alternative

Repeated back-to-back local Playwright runs surfaced a moving target of different flaky tests each time (4.10 → 4.11 → 2.1) due to ambient stack load, wasting several run cycles before switching to the CI-equivalent timeout regime

CI=1 flips `webServer.reuseExistingServer` off, conflicting with an already-running local API stack — required a temporary (reverted) playwright.config.ts patch to force reuse while still getting the CI timeout floor
Hook JSON in GSD's plan:pre config contains raw/control characters inside string values, breaking both `--raw` output parsing and naive JSON.parse — required writing a custom lenient parser script
Earlier `git cat-file` checks on HEAD tree contents gave a false negative (said completed/ todo copies weren't in HEAD when they actually were), requiring a second decisive check to reconcile
lint-staged git commit hung/timed out at 2 minutes (suspected 1Password SSH signing prompt) despite the commit actually landing successfully, requiring a manual verification step
sdk-e2e Test 21 flaked on PR #601 (lacking the fix landed on #600) — required explaining to the user that the fix belonged on #600 and would need a rebase/merge-order dependency
